text: Ombudsman Toronto has submitted a report for consideration by the TTC Board. As the Ombudsman's investigation is not complete, this report remains confidential under s.173(1) of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.

The TTC Board: 1. Adopted the action taken in-camera and authorized that the confidential information remain confidential as it contains information about an ongoing Ombudsman investigation, pursuant to subsection 173(1) of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
